audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio track opens with a high-energy male narrator speaking Mandarin with an enthusiastic, high-arousal tone. He is accompanied by a continuous electronic pop background music track featuring a steady 128 BPM four-on-the-floor kick drum and bright synthesizer pads. (2) A sharp 'ding' sound effect, serving as a Digital UI SFX, signals a game highlight, immediately followed by the narrator raising his vocal pitch and volume to shout a word of praise. The game's internal magic effects produce high-frequency 'whoosh' sounds that occupy the upper spectral range. (3) A series of rapid impact sound effects, categorized as Hit SFX, occur as game characters engage in combat. The narrator's speech rate increases to match the visual action, while the BGM maintains its upbeat tempo. (4) The phase is marked by a vocal inflection shift as the narrator chuckles, followed by a comedic 'boing' or cartoon sound effect used for emphasis. The ambient noise floor remains extremely clean, consistent with a professional studio-quality vocal recording mixed over a mastered music track. (5) The final phase features the narrator delivering a quick closing remark while the music and game SFX continue at a high density, creating a sense of information overload common in social-media gaming edits.
